question: Should the fail-closed validation-command grammar, explicit non-live proof-subsumption mechanism, and strict server-side base-binding requirement become the permanent repair merge boundary?
rationale: These choices deliberately govern cross-repository command execution, proof omission, credential trust, and when automated repair merges must stop despite otherwise passing checks.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Merge the final green head and require focused tests for every future supported command form or proof-subsumption contract.

options.title: Disable subsumption initially
options.body: Land staged proof and strict base binding while keeping repository-profile proof subsumption unused pending separate approval.

options.title: Split the boundaries
options.body: Land deterministic staging first and review command grammar, subsumption, and merge authorization in narrower follow-up changes.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
recommendation.body: Merge the final green head and require focused tests for every future supported command form or proof-subsumption contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history identifies him as the clearest owner of the affected repair validation and merge automation surface.
